summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Young's Double Slit Experiment simulation. All core features working correctly including canvas rendering, physics calculations, interactive controls, and mobile responsiveness.

ui_bugs.issue: Some decimal values (like '3.0', '2.0') cause 'Malformed value' error when using .fill() method
ui_bugs.workaround: Sliders work perfectly when dragged manually, only affects programmatic testing

passed_tests: Page loads correctly with all components visible
Experiment canvas renders laser, barrier, slits, wavefronts, and screen with interference pattern
Intensity graph displays proper I(y) curve with wavelength-based colors
Wavelength slider changes color from violet (380nm) to red (750nm)
Slit width slider updates simulation (0.01-0.5mm range)
Slit separation slider updates fringe spacing (0.1-3.0mm range)
Reset button restores all parameters to defaults (550nm, 0.08mm, 0.5mm, 1.0m)
Wavefront toggle turns Huygens wavefronts on/off correctly
Fringe width readout updates with parameter changes
Physics calculations accurate (smaller slit separation = larger fringe width)
Mobile responsive design works at 390x844 viewport
All data-testid attributes present and functional
Color mapping accurate across electromagnetic spectrum
Canvas animations and real-time updates working
